components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-emphasis action on a screen. Signal Orange, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Medium-emphasis action. Muted gray fill, no color.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis bordered action with hairline lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field. Hairline border at rest, Signal-Orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--destructive); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { font-size: 0.875rem; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, border-defined container with subtle resting shadow. Never nested, never side-striped.
components.html:
Amsterdam AI Builders
A weekly gathering of engineers shipping with agents.

components.name: Badge

components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Section Label

components.css: .ds-section-label { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Nav Link

components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-story-timeline { list-style: none; padding: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-story-entry { position: relative; padding: 0 0 32px 28px; } .ds-story-entry::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 4px; left: -5px; width: 10px; height: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--foreground); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--background); } .ds-story-date { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-story-title { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 600; } .ds-story-context { margin: 20px 0 0; max-width: 65ch; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-story-evidence { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-story-evidence summary { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-story-evidence summary:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-story-evidence blockquote { margin: 12px 0 0; padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted-foreground); line-height: 1.625; } .ds-story-source { display: inline-flex; margin-top: 16px; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 14px; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-story-evidence summary:focus-visible, .ds-story-source:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ink Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--foreground); color:var(--background); font:500 14px var(--font-sans); cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--foreground) 85%,transparent); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-ink:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; }

components.css: .ds-community { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; background:var(--card); color:var(--card-foreground); text-decoration:none; font:14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition:background 150ms,border-color 150ms; } .ds-community-name { font-size:16px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.375; } .ds-community-about { color:var(--muted-foreground); display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; } .ds-community-meta { margin-top:auto; color:var(--muted-foreground); font:12px var(--font-mono); } .ds-community:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--muted) 40%,transparent); border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--foreground) 30%,transparent); } .ds-community:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } @media (min-width:640px) { .ds-community { padding:16px; } }

narrative.overview:
AIT Community is a town square where engineers and AI agents gather to build together. The square is built on a precise technical grid — monospace labels, OKLCH tokens, ruled borders, an orange-dot wordmark — but the grid is the _pavement_, not the point. Warmth comes from the people, the imagery (the illustrated isometric town square, the village landscape), the language, and the disciplined use of a single warm accent. The system reads as _well-built and welcoming at the same time_: you can tell an engineer made this, and you can tell you're meant to belong here.

The system is **balanced**: one shared core of tokens, type, and components serves both the public square (home, communities directory, members leaderboard, blog, benchmark, impact) and the workshops behind it (dashboards, community settings, event and challenge workspaces, classroom). Public surfaces get more expressive latitude — bigger type, more imagery, more air — but they never invent a parallel system. App surfaces are information-dense by necessity, and they earn warmth through clear hierarchy and human copy, not by stripping function. A member should feel the same product whether they're on the homepage or three levels deep in an event workspace.

This system explicitly **rejects** four things. It is not a **generic SaaS template** (no cream/sand backgrounds, no gradient hero text, no hero-metric blocks, no endless identical icon+heading+text card grids). It is not a **cold, sterile dashboard** (density without coldness — never an all-gray enterprise admin panel). It is not **crypto/Web3 hype** (no neon-on-black, no aggressive gradients, no "to the moon" energy). And it is not **corporate or stuffy** (no stock photography, no navy-and-gray, no jargon).
keyCharacteristics: Pure-white (or true-dark) canvas, never tinted warm-neutral cream.
One warm accent — Signal Orange — used sparingly and on purpose.
Geist Sans for everything human; Geist Mono reserved for the house `/ LABEL` voice, stats, and timestamps.
Border-defined, flat-by-default surfaces with subtle lift on interaction.

rules.name: The Semantic-Status Rule
rules.body: Status color comes only from these four tokens — never raw Tailwind palette classes (`text-green-600`, `bg-red-500`, `text-amber-600`) and never a hardcoded hex. If a state needs color, it maps to success/warning/info/destructive. Categorical things that are NOT a status (challenge difficulty, post type, tags) are NOT status colors — use neutral Badges whose label carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Pair-With-A-Cue Rule
rules.body: Status is never communicated by color alone (8% of men can't distinguish red/green). Every status color ships with an icon, label, or shape — a check for success, an alert glyph for warning, etc.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears on ≤10% of any given screen. It marks the single most important action or the active state — nothing else. If two things on a screen are orange, one of them is wrong. When a screen's main actions are equal peers there is no single most important action: render them all as Ink buttons and spend no orange on them.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: The body background is pure white (`oklch(1 0 0)`) or true dark (`oklch(0.145 0 0)`). Never a warm-tinted near-white. The instant a surface drifts toward cream/sand/parchment, it reads as a generic AI-generated landing page — the exact anti-reference.

rules.name: The Chart-Containment Rule
rules.body: The five chart hues live inside data viz and nowhere else. UI chrome is neutral + Signal Orange, full stop. (Documented exceptions with their own tokens: the heat ramp and the emblem hues above.)

rules.name: The House Kicker Rule
rules.body: The monospace `/ LABEL` (e.g. `/ COMMUNITIES`, `/ MEMBERS`) is the one sanctioned eyebrow and it is a _system_, not decoration. Use it as a consistent section marker. Do not also sprinkle uppercase tracked eyebrows or `01 · 02 · 03` numbered markers on top of it — that's the AI-grammar tell. Numbers earn their place only when the section truly is an ordered sequence.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Machine Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for the machine voice: labels, code, stats, IDs, timestamps. Member bios, community descriptions, and any warm human copy are Geist Sans. Monospace everywhere is how the town square turns cold.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting surface is border-defined and nearly flat. Reach for a heavier shadow only when an element is _floating_ (overlay) or _responding_ (hover/active). If a static card has a big soft shadow, it's wrong — that's the 2014-app tell.

rules.name: The Border-Carries-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated by borders and tonal steps first, shadow second. Removing every shadow should still leave the hierarchy legible.

rules.name: The Gate-Before-Fail Rule
rules.body: A guest must never click an enabled control that then fails. Pick the gate by surface:

rules.name: The No-Silent-Failure Rule
rules.body: Every data fetch handles three states explicitly: loading → `<Skeleton>`; error → `<ErrorState onRetry>` (or hide, for purely supplementary widgets); empty → `<EmptyState>` (or hide). **Never** `if (!data) return null` as the only branch — a failed load must be distinguishable from "nothing here." Errored core sections show the error + retry; only optional/supplementary widgets may stay quietly absent.

rules.name: Magazine Publication Exception
rules.body: Approved editorial shell for issue/article reading and the inert builder preview. Dedicated community return, shelf and contents navigation; large selected display type, a cover readability scrim, flowing stories, and publication information below. Font setting stays magazine-wide; global site UI retains Geist.

dos: **Do** keep the body background pure white (`oklch(1 0 0)`) or true dark (`oklch(0.145 0 0)`). Carry warmth through copy, imagery, and the accent — never a tinted cream surface.
**Do** ration Signal Orange to ≤10% of a screen (the One Voice Rule). At most one primary action, one active state; equal peer actions use the Ink button instead.
**Do** use the monospace `/ LABEL` as the one consistent section marker, and only there.
**Do** define surfaces with full hairline borders and tonal layering; reserve shadows for floating or responding elements.
**Do** pair every status color with a non-color cue (icon, label, pattern) — leaderboards, validation, charts, agent-vs-human.

**Do** express all status color through the four semantic tokens (`success`/`warning`/`info`/`destructive`) — use `bg-success/15 text-success` for soft badges, `bg-success text-success-foreground` for solid fills.
**Do** test headings and labels in both English and Dutch; layouts must absorb longer NL strings without overflow.
**Do** give every Framer Motion animation a `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback, and ensure reveals enhance already-visible content rather than gating it.
**Do** keep body text ≥4.5:1 (large ≥3:1); never push `text-muted` lighter than `oklch(0.556 0 0)` on white.
donts: **Don't** ship a **generic SaaS template** look: no cream/sand backgrounds, gradient hero text (`background-clip:text`), hero-metric blocks, or endless identical icon+heading+text card grids.
**Don't** let app surfaces become a **cold, sterile dashboard** — density is fine, all-gray soulless admin panels are not.
**Don't** drift toward **crypto/Web3 hype**: no neon-on-black, aggressive gradients, or "to the moon" energy.
**Don't** go **corporate/stuffy**: no stock photography, navy-and-gray palettes, or jargon-heavy copy.
**Don't** use a colored `border-left`/`border-right` stripe (>1px) as an accent on cards, list items, or alerts. Use full borders, background tints, or leading icons.
**Don't** nest cards, and don't give resting cards heavy soft shadows.
**Don't** stack extra eyebrows or `01 / 02 / 03` numbered markers on top of the `/ LABEL` system.
**Don't** spend Geist Mono on warm human copy (bios, community descriptions) — that's how the square turns cold.
**Don't** borrow chart colors into UI chrome.

**Don't** use raw Tailwind palette classes (`text-green-600`, `bg-red-500/15`, `text-amber-600`, `text-zinc-400`) or hardcoded hex for status — map to `success`/`warning`/`info`/`destructive`. (~1,170 of these exist today; they are the consistency debt being retired.)
**Don't** color a categorical attribute (challenge difficulty, post type, tags) as if it were a status — use a neutral Badge whose label carries the meaning.
